title: 折磨：扭蒙拉之潮 子非鱼汉化
method: 主对话内置 image_gen，以官方原画为参考生成；未使用外部CLI/API
visual_check: 主对话已查看修改成图：子非鱼汉化五字完整正确，游戏名与英文标题正确可读，原构图和人物群像保持。
reuse: 后续发布复用 Dispatch/title-zifeiyu.png；原版 Dispatch/title.png 保留，未加入安装载荷，未发布。
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ads-marketing. Create one finished landscape Chinese localization release cover for Torment: Tides of Numenera, approximately 16:9.
Input image 1 (official Steam library hero): primary edit target and artwork. Preserve the recognizable official painted character montage, masked hooded central figure and companions, astronomical star-map lines and dark indigo blue background, antique gold illumination, and delicate pale-blue magical flourishes. Input image 2 (official Steam header): reference for original logo styling only.
Recompose the very wide hero into a polished cinematic landscape cover, retaining its official artwork style and characters, with the character medallion on the right and beautiful typography in the generous space on the left. Do not stretch faces; do not invent extra characters. Maintain the restrained mysterious science-fantasy painterly aesthetic.
Text must be exactly these Chinese strings, clearly legible and spelled correctly: large main title "折磨"; second title line "扭蒙拉之潮"; third line "汉化". Create refined custom Chinese display lettering with elegant sharp wedge serifs, subtly weathered metal, antique gold edges and cool silver-blue faces, inspired by the original TORMENT logo. Make 汉化 prominent and stylish, integrated with delicate blue tidal energy and fine gold geometric ornament, not a flat sticker. Chinese characters must remain structurally correct, especially 扭、蒙、拉、潮.
A small, restrained English line "TORMENT: TIDES OF NUMENERA" may appear above the Chinese title. No other text, version numbers, fake awards, watermark, download links, or UI. Preserve a high-end editorial hierarchy and generous margins. Finished opaque artwork, no transparency.
